title: N-Body Orbital Sandbox
description: A minimal browser-based gravity simulator for exploring orbital motion and prototyping new interactive experiments.

title: Carbon Reduction Plan
description: A focused web project for presenting carbon reduction information in a simple, maintainable interface.

title: Wildfire Story Lab
description: An experimental storytelling tool for exploring how climate and wildfire narratives can be communicated interactively.

title: Contrast Lab
description: A WCAG 2.x colour contrast checker for testing foreground and background pairs against AA and AAA accessibility thresholds.

title: Component Sandbox
description: A live gallery of the Astro UI blocks used across rjmlaird.co.uk, each rendered with its source snippet underneath.

title: Climate Visualiser
description: A science-communication project that turns temperature anomaly data into a readable chart with plain-English annotations.

title: Mechanics
description: An interactive classical mechanics lab featuring four real-time simulations built on a shared physics engine: ramp forces and friction, Newton's cradle momentum transfers, projectile motion with independent SUVAT equations, and vehicle stopping distances.

title: Graphs
description: A modular pre-launch template designed for data visualization, custom charting, and analytical metric rendering.

title: satellites
description: A live orbital tracker utilizing SGP4 propagation of Celestrak's GP catalog, cross-referenced with SATCAT and rendered interactively via Leaflet maps.

title: drought
description: A comprehensive UK drought risk monitor combining live Copernicus European Drought Observatory (EDO/GDO) indicators with real-time Environment Agency and SEPA hydrology data.

title: tintwistle
description: A pre-launch environmental or geographical monitoring experiment focused on the Tintwistle area, currently in development.

title: biodiversity
description: A habitat health monitor combining satellite-derived vegetation greenness (NDVI), live designated nature reserve boundaries (NNR, LNR, SSSI), and river water quality archives.

title: sewage
description: A real-time monitoring tool tracking raw-sewage storm overflow activations (EDMs) across Severn Trent Water and Anglian Water, contextualised with Copernicus soil moisture and rainfall anomalies.

title: astro
description: A pre-launch exploratory tool dedicated to astronomical data processing, space missions, or celestial mechanics.

title: atmosphere
description: A multi-tiered vertical air quality profile tracking nitrogen dioxide, ozone, and particulates over Leicestershire by blending Copernicus CAMS regional models with real-world AURN ground stations.
